entry.title: OpenAI’s Revenue Run Rate Tops $40 Billion Ahead of IPO
entry.summary: OpenAI is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $40 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar with the matter, roughly doubling its run rate from the end of 2025 and bolstering the company’s plans for a Wall Street debut.

entry.title: Mark Bezos’ Fund Faces Fight to Recoup Losses From Fence Startup
entry.summary: A venture capital firm co-founded by Jeff Bezos’ younger brother Mark sank $11.7 million into a startup that fashioned itself as an Uber of fence installation. Now it’s suing the startup’s founder after the company’s collapse amid allegations of fraud and mismanagement.

entry.title: Nvidia-Backed Startup CodeRabbit Valued at $1.5 Billion in Round
entry.summary: CodeRabbit Inc., an artificial intelligence-powered code review service, has raised $143 million in a new funding round, tapping into demand for tools to spot flaws in AI-generated software programming.

entry.title: Whoop Plans to Double Size of Boston Headquarters Ahead of IPO
entry.summary: Whoop Inc., the maker of popular screenless fitness trackers, plans to roughly double the size of its Boston headquarters, boosting a city struggling to grab a bigger piece of the artificial intelligence boom.

entry.title: Wintermute Plans $1 Billion AI Investment to Compete on Wall Street
entry.summary: Wintermute Trading Ltd. intends to invest about $1 billion in high-frequency trading and artificial intelligence data center infrastructure over the next five years, as the digital assets market maker looks to diversify into traditional markets following a slump in crypto.

entry.title: AI Coding Startup Lovable Raises $400 Million at $13.3 Billion Valuation
entry.summary: Swedish coding startup Lovable has raised funding at a $13.3 billion valuation, bringing in fresh capital to compete with larger rivals like Anthropic and Elon Musk’s SpaceX.

entry.title: OpenAI lets employees cash out another $7 billion in stock
entry.summary: OpenAI wrapped up a $7 billion stock buyback, letting current and former employees sell shares at the company's $852 billion valuation. The move is meant to ease pressure on employees waiting for liquidity ahead of a potential IPO. OpenAI ran a similar $6.6 billion sale in October 2025. entry.title: Accel Raises $3.5 Billion to Invest in Emerging Global AI Startups
entry.summary: Accel, a global venture capital firm with offices in Silicon Valley, London and Bangalore, India, has raised $3.5 billion in new funds for early-stage investments across the world.
